title: ECI Review Result — standalone output contract v1.1
$comment: Local draft implementing engineering-review-design.md and eci-review-requirements.md; not a published Knowledge contract. Shape validation does not establish reference integrity, coverage, evidence truth, or authorization.

extensions.description: Namespaced optional extension data; never substitutes for required core fields.

objects.description: Local object definitions where needed; native references can be used directly and resolved against authoritative sources.

relations.description: Actual reviewed relationship records; shared native references allowed.

constraints.description: Locally recorded constraint definitions; adopted native constraints may be referenced directly.

discovery_obligations.description: Actual discovery obligations identified from adopted rules and scope, including unknown relations.

required_obligations.description: Concrete obligations identified by the review implementation; not a caller-supplied denominator or proof of completeness.

fact_snapshot_ref.description: Optional actual native snapshot reference, not a mandatory new artifact.

description: Standalone review output. No caller-prepared ReviewInput or input digest required. Review execution discovers facts and obligations; semantic validation independently checks native sources and adopted rules.
